**Execution / interactions:** All summons share the root cast ownership and count against per-caster/global summon budgets. Does not duplicate story/boss entities.

**Master parameters / safety:** Static temporary combat summons only, notRevive/Simulacrum/Dominate. Count+1, all created summons HPanddamage\*.75; no duplicated corpse token.

**Fixture:** accept Wolf Summon; reject Revive Fallen (Cannot duplicate one corpse claim). Maximum one copy per skill. Display the rejected gate in UI and revalidate it server-side.

**Presentation:** Reuse the linked skill's icon with an external passive badge; update affected telegraph geometry/timing, not just the tooltip. Repeats and child effects inherit the family template and owner cleanup. No bespoke passive art is a mechanics requirement.

## LP-059. Minion Empowerment

rpg.passive.minion\_empowerment • Phase 10 • SPECIALIST • 80 Insight/copy

**Compatibility gate:** Family: Summon/Proxy; capability: TemporarySummon.

**Exact baseline effect:** Increase linked summons' maximum Health and damage/effect by 30%, but reduce their duration by 25%.

**Execution / interactions:** Duration reduction cannot push a summon below the configured minimum lifetime. Permanent/persistent authored companions are not eligible.

**Master parameters / safety:** SummonHP/damage*1.30, duration*.75. Revive works after its base clamps; hardfamily ceiling 8 active summons/caster still applies.

**Fixture:** accept Revive Fallen; reject Dominate (Conversion is not a temporary created summon). Maximum one copy per skill. Display the rejected gate in UI and revalidate it server-side.

**Presentation:** Reuse the linked skill's icon with an external passive badge; update affected telegraph geometry/timing, not just the tooltip. Repeats and child effects inherit the family template and owner cleanup. No bespoke passive art is a mechanics requirement.

## LP-060. Death Pact

rpg.passive.death\_pact • Phase 10 • SPECIALIST • 80 Insight/copy

**Compatibility gate:** Family: Summon/Proxy; capability: TemporaryCombatSummon.

**Exact baseline effect:** When a linked summon dies or expires, it explodes in a 3 m radius for 60% of the linked summon skill's normal damage-effect power.

**Execution / interactions:** Explosion inherits the summon skill's primary damage element when defined. It cannot trigger another Death Pact, and forced cleanup on logout/world unload does not deal damage.

**Master parameters / safety:** Natural expiry or enemy kill causesone 3 m burst at.60 caster-snapshot ted offensive power. Voluntary sacrifice/logout/unload/replace never explodes. No lootrewards, repeatproc or extra summon.

**Fixture:** accept Wolf Summon; reject Simulacrum (Noncombat decoy excluded). Maximum one copy per skill. Display the rejected gate in UI and revalidate it server-side.

## LP-061. Lifeblood

rpg.passive.lifeblood • Phase 11 • SPECIALIST • 80 Insight/copy

**Compatibility gate:** Finite upfront Mana or Stamina cost; excludes Aura, Reservation, Channel, Reaction, Triggered, and indefinite Toggle skills.

**Exact baseline effect:** Pay Health instead of the linked skill's normal Mana/Stamina cost. Health cost is 150% of the original numeric resource cost, and linked effect magnitude is increased by 10%.

**Execution / interactions:** Cast fails if payment would reduce the player below 1 Health. It never converts continuous upkeep or Mana Reservation to Health.

**Master parameters / safety:** Explicit exception toMana/Stamina-onlyspending: nonlethal Health cost ce il(1.50\*compiled numeric cost); require current HP\>cost. Damage/heal/barrier+.10 Increased; noLeeching pairing, no Health reservation.

**Fixture:** accept Quick Slash; reject Void Beam (Channel upkeep is not an upfront-only cost). Maximum one copy per skill. Display the rejected gate in UI and revalidate it server-side.

**Presentation:** Reuse the linked skill's icon with an external passive badge; update affected telegraph geometry/timing, not just the tooltip. Repeats and child effects inherit the family template and owner cleanup. No bespoke passive art is a mechanics requirement.

## LP-062. Attunement

rpg.passive.attunement • Phase 11 • SPECIALIST • 80 Insight/copy

**Compatibility gate:** Capability: DiscreteActivation \+ finite resource cost.

**Exact baseline effect:** Successful repeated uses within 4 seconds build up to 5 Attunement stacks. Each stack grants \+3% effect magnitude and \-3% resource cost to the linked skill.

**Execution / interactions:** Using another skill does not clear stacks; only 4 seconds without committing this linked skill clears them. Maximum at 5 stacks: \+15% effect, \-15% cost.

**Master parameters / safety:** Benefit uses existing stacks at commit; that successful manual commit then adds one stack, maximum five. Each stack adds 3% Increased magnitude and reduces base cost additively by 3%. Clear after 4 s without this skill, or a loadout change; other skills do not clear it.

**Fixture:** accept Quick Slash; reject Managuard (Not discrete finite-cost use). Maximum one copy per skill. Display the rejected gate in UI and revalidate it server-side.

**Presentation:** Reuse the linked skill's icon with an external passive badge; update affected telegraph geometry/timing, not just the tooltip. Repeats and child effects inherit the family template and owner cleanup. No bespoke passive art is a mechanics requirement.

## LP-063. Leeching

rpg.passive.leeching • Phase 11 • SPECIALIST • 80 Insight/copy

**Compatibility gate:** Payload: Damage; ResourceType: Mana or Stamina.

**Exact baseline effect:** Restore the linked skill's declared resource equal to 3% of final damage dealt, capped at 8% of maximum resource per root cast.

**Execution / interactions:** Only damage actually applied after Hytale mitigation contributes. Damage to invalid/friendly/immune targets restores nothing. Periodic hits share the same root-cast cap.

**Master parameters / safety:** Return 3% of actual HP damage to the linked skill's resource, capped at 8% of spendable maximum per root. Exclude overkill, shield absorption, reflection and costs. All descendants share the cap. Incompatible with Lifeblood.

**Fixture:** accept Fireball; reject Emanatism (No damage or spend resource). Maximum one copy per skill. Display the rejected gate in UI and revalidate it server-side.

**Presentation:** Reuse the linked skill's icon with an external passive badge; update affected telegraph geometry/timing, not just the tooltip. Repeats and child effects inherit the family template and owner cleanup. No bespoke passive art is a mechanics requirement.

## LP-064. Retaliation

rpg.passive.retaliation • Phase 11 • SPECIALIST • 80 Insight/copy

**Compatibility gate:** Capability: DiscreteActivation; excludes Aura, Channel, Stance, Movement, Reaction, Triggered, Transformation, and indefinite Toggle.

**Exact baseline effect:** Disable manual activation. After the player accumulates incoming damage equal to 15% of maximum Health, automatically execute the linked skill at 70% effect, then reset the damage accumulator.

**Execution / interactions:** Trigger respects the linked skill cooldown, target requirements, and resource cost unless the SkillDefinition explicitly supports self-triggering without a target. Damage caused by reflected/recursive trigger chains does not advance the accumulator. Triggered execution cannot trigger Retaliation again.

**Master parameters / safety:** Accumulate actual hostile HP loss over a rolling 10 s window against 15% maximum HP. Queue at most one cast and attempt no more than once per second. Recheck resources, cooldown and target; failed attempts retain at most one threshold. Manual activation is disabled.

**Fixture:** accept Frost Nova; reject Corpse Burst (Cannot automatically select/consume a corpse). Maximum one copy per skill. Display the rejected gate in UI and revalidate it server-side.

## LP-065. Critical Trigger

rpg.passive.critical\_trigger • Phase 11 • SPECIALIST • 80 Insight/copy

**Compatibility gate:** Capability: CanCrit \+ DiscreteActivation; excludes Aura, Channel, Reaction, Triggered, Transformation, and indefinite Toggle.

**Exact baseline effect:** When the linked skill scores a critical hit, repeat its primary execution once at 50% effect after 0.20 seconds. Internal cooldown: 1.5 seconds.

**Execution / interactions:** The derived repeat pays no additional resource/cooldown and cannot trigger Critical Trigger. It reuses the same target/location when still valid; otherwise the trigger is discarded rather than silently retargeted.

**Master parameters / safety:** Only a root direct critical result schedules one repeat, after 0.20 s at 50% effect with 1.5 s internal cooldown. Exclude Movement, Summon, Corpse, Barrier, Aura, Channel and other repeat controllers. Invalid original target cancels the repeat.

**Fixture:** accept Snipe; reject Chilling Aura (Periodic Aura excluded). Maximum one copy per skill. Display the rejected gate in UI and revalidate it server-side.

rpg.passive.kill\_trigger • Phase 11 • SPECIALIST • 80 Insight/copy

**Compatibility gate:** Payload: Damage; capability: DiscreteActivation \+ CanAcquireEnemyTarget; excludes Aura, Channel, Reaction, Triggered, Transformation, and indefinite Toggle.

**Exact baseline effect:** When the linked skill kills an enemy, repeat the primary execution at 50% effect toward the nearest valid enemy within 12 m. Internal cooldown: 1.0 second.

**Execution / interactions:** The derived repeat pays no additional resource/cooldown and cannot trigger Kill Trigger. For ground-targeted skills, the new target's location becomes the derived ground point. If no valid target exists, nothing is spawned.

**Master parameters / safety:** One repeat per root at 50% effect, aimed at the nearest valid enemy within 12 m of the killed target and within legal caster reach; internal cooldown 1 s. Exclude corpse, summon and movement consumers. Derived kills cannot repeat again.

**Fixture:** accept Fireball; reject Wolf Summon (Summon operation cannot be replayed generically). Maximum one copy per skill. Display the rejected gate in UI and revalidate it server-side.

**Presentation:** Reuse the linked skill's icon with an external passive badge; update affected telegraph geometry/timing, not just the tooltip. Repeats and child effects inherit the family template and owner cleanup. No bespoke passive art is a mechanics requirement.

# 11\. Family-first implementation program and exit gates

The phase table below defines the execution order. A phase is not permission to implement every listed skill at once: first build a reusable executor with one or two pilots, then accept content cohorts of at most six skills or four passives. The phase manifest lists each record's destination. Any phase with unresolved API evidence is BLOCKED, not “done with a silent workaround.” Art approval is never a prerequisite; a clear shipped template is sufficient.

Before each cohort, freeze source/plan hashes, take a save backup, record the current test baseline and list the files/systems that may change. After each cohort, run the prior regression set plus new fixtures and produce a report. Stop after the approved exit gate. No unattended progression into the next cohort, no automatic deployment, and no broad architecture rewrite merely to fix one content row.

## Phase 00\. Evidence and feasibility

| Entry | No RPG gameplay changes |
| Bounded scope | Pin server/client/SDK/asset hashes; inventory existing repo systems; prove native resource/damage hooks, CustomUIHud/CustomPage lifecycle, native Health/Mana/Stamina visibility, the pan/drag/key/spline Link UI, and global keyboard ownership. Probe all available Ability inputs. Prove or disprove a supported C camera-flip unbind/remap, C Character binding, K Link Tree binding, and native Inventory-page extension path. Export particle/item/animation/audio/NPC catalogs. |
| Exit evidence | Build and client smoke report; UI drag/pan demonstration; standalone Character page open/close proof; custom HUD layer proof; exact supported-input map including C/K and current C camera action; explicit Inventory-extension result; no invented API, client patch or asset IDs. Unsupported feature gets named blocker, not silent substitute. |
| Rollback | Pure audit branch; revert only audit additions. Do not change production saves or permanent client bindings. |

**Cohort boundary:** first prove the shared primitive with pilots; then batches of no more than six skills or four passives. Stop after each approved gate.

Do not report an in-game test when only mocks or pure math ran. Do not describe a particle as reviewed because its ID exists. # 12\. Test matrix, safety budgets and operational behaviour

## 12.1 Pure contract tests

Required parameterized tests: attribute boundaries 149/150/151, 249/250/251, 349/350/351, 449/450/451; resource baseline 10; raw 500 reference values; negative allocation-request rejection, defined zero-clamp behaviour for raw-attribute math, and nonfinite input rejection; all 98 XP transitions and 99 cumulative entries; rounding half-up; reservation combinations 10/20/50%, overflow rejection, repeated toggles and gear-cap changes; cooldown recovery versus duration scaling; crit caps; mastery cap; source uniqueness; all source/skill/passive IDs; retired concepts excluded.

Graph tests cover every legal/illegal node-type edge, cycles through both joints, three-port capacity, direct six-passive specialization, missing sinks, duplicate passive copies, invalid replacement, graph-revision conflicts, layout-only edits and reopen/reconnect. Compile tests reorder node positions and edge insertion order while requiring identical effective plan hashes. A node's location must never alter the passive priority order. Character/HUD pure tests cover pendingLevelUpPoints subset invariants, \+5 per newly earned level, pending-first allocation consumption, level99 XP presentation, the ten-pip fill formula at 0/9.9/10/50/99.9/100%, resource-strip ordering Mana|Health|Stamina, logical four-slot projection, C/K edge-trigger debouncing, and restoration of hidden native HUD components after teardown.

Compatibility coverage requires 87 x 66=5,742 skill-passive assessments and all 2,145 unordered passive pairs to be classified, including explicit “not applicable” cases rather than assumed acceptance. Not every pair needs a separate in-game run: validate the deterministic matrix, execute primitive-level pair tests and fuzz valid graphs of up to six passives. Add golden examples for Fireball(Potency+Echo+SkillDelay), Fireball(Pierce+Fork+Chain+Return), GroundZone(MobileDomain+Expanded Radius), Aura(Conservation+Resonance), Managuard(SharedAegis+Reflective Ward), and clearly rejected QuickSlash+Chain / Managuard+Resonance. Source-changing updates regenerate the matrix and flag changed eligibility.

## 12.2 Connected gameplay acceptance

Each skill needs one positive and one cancellation/invalid-target recording on the pinned client. Show its cost, cooldown, geometry, impact count, statuses, visual ownership and cleanup. Channel tests include frame/tick jitter and low Mana at a scheduled pulse. Projectile tests cover targets moving into/out of path, walls, stairs, distant expiration, return miss and a caster moving after commit. Shield tests include overkill, invulnerability, redirect plus reflection, no loops and no resource credit for absorbed damage. Summon tests include owner logout, target death, corpse competition, elite revive, boss rejection and allegiance restoration. UI acceptance additionally records: C opens/closes Character without firing the old reverse-camera action; K opens/closes Link Tree; switching between them never stacks pages; Tab still opens Inventory; each Character \+ button changes exactly one server-owned attribute point; the level-up notice survives reconnect until pending points reach zero; XP pips match threshold math before/after a level boundary; the four Skill HUD cells mirror equipped logical slots; Mana/Health/Stamina displayed values match EntityStatMap while reservations alter only spendable Mana maximum; mod/UI teardown restores native resource HUD visibility.

Visual acceptance is geometry and feedback parity: an enemy cannot be damaged outside the shown footprint beyond a 0.25 m sampling tolerance, a warning cannot appear after its impact, a harmless range expiration cannot show a damaging explosion, and ally/enemy effects remain distinguishable with color disabled. Artist-approved polish is recorded separately. The current artifact's diagrams are design references, not screenshots of tested implementation.

## 12.3 Performance targets and fault containment

NEW BASELINE acceptance targets, not measured claims: on a declared test machine, RPG simulation adds no more than 4 ms at p95 and 8 ms at p99 per server tick in the four-player combat scenario. Measure a local battle with four players, 16 hostile targets, 24 projectiles/caster, 8 fields/caster and 8 summons/caster, then a scaling scenario with the deployment's intended player count. Record server tick budget and base-game load separately. UI drag/pan should respond within 50 ms locally and final authoritative Apply within 250 ms under a documented network profile. Character page open/close and C/K toggles should present first usable frame within 100 ms locally; routine HUD updates should be event-driven or bounded to \<=10 Hz for non-animation data, with client-side bar interpolation where available. Art/ambient LOD changes cannot alter server damage.

Initial global admission caps are 512 live RPG projectile carriers, 128 persistent fields and 256 summons. These are conservative starting limits, not claims about Hytale performance; scaling profiles require load-test evidence. Reject admission before cost when capacity is unavailable, and never drop already accepted hit results to meet a cosmetic budget. Keep spatial searches bounded to 64 candidate entities per ordinary effect query and 256 for approved apex geometry; select by deterministic distance/ID, not iteration order. If an encounter exceeds the cap, schedule deterministic partitions within the same logical resolve, or reject the profile during load testing rather than silently dropping half its targets. Limit ongoing active roots by owner and global build profile. A safe cancellation must clear callbacks, entity handles, reservations, graph subscriptions and presentation owners once. Expensive eligibility/plan compilation happens on edits, not per frame or per victim.

Fault tests: missing artist icon pack; missing named candidate particle; malformed template; unsupported UI event; unavailable global C/K binding; failed restoration of the previous C camera binding; native Inventory extension unavailable; unknown DamageCause; cancelled asynchronous save; corrupted progress; duplicate reward event; server restart during a delayed cast; chunk unload during summon/conversion; art-pack reload mid-Aura; old content ID after rename. Hotkey or native-Inventory limitations produce explicit adapter blockers; they must never silently mutate controls or corrupt gameplay state. Only failures affecting safety/authority/required presentation block the corresponding content. Log once per bounded incident key, not every tick.

## 12.4 Release and rollback

Separate code, content, adapter, schema and art versions in a signed or checksum-verified manifest. Retain last-good content and a pre-migration save backup. Deployment requires operator approval, schema validation and a rollback drill on a copied world. Disable new content/families without deleting learned-skill ownership; show a disabled reason until the version is restored. Never downgrade save schema in place without a tested reverse migration. Never replay journal rewards after rollback without matching event IDs.

Debug commands require explicit server permission and are disabled to ordinary clients. Proposed commands: rpg audit, rpg content validate, rpg skill grant , rpg passive grant , rpg progress inspect, rpg cast trace, rpg graph validate, rpg vfx preview  and rpg reset-test-character. Destructive reset is test-character-only and requires confirmation. Grant commands append operator/audit metadata and cannot masquerade as earned progression.

# 13\. Numeric implementation reference and worked examples

The accompanying balance\_reference.py is executable reference math, not a Hytale implementation. Its test report only certifies agreement with this document's authored formulas. Values are calculated with explicit half-up rounding; XP uses 64-bit integers. Base 10 attributes and the shared soft-cap curve produce no hidden class offsets.

Worked damage example: WeaponPower 20, rawDEX150 \-\>attribute multiplier 1.45; Snipe 2.00 \-\>58 pre-mitigation damage. Potency adds 15% in the Increased bucket \-\>66.7; a 1.5 critical \-\>100.05 before native mitigation. Do not multiply by native fully charged damage again. A displayed critical marker does not change the amount after application.

Worked reservation example: TotalMana 100, Managuard 50%, Pedanticism 20%, Emanatism 10% \-\>reserved 80, spendable maximum 20\. Managuard base capacity 50\. Turning off Managuard expands spendable capacity to 70 but does not add 50 current Mana; passive regen/rest fills available capacity normally. Emanatism turns 1.5 Mana/s into 1.875 Mana/s at this total maximum before other regen bonuses, capped at the spendable maximum. It does not turn a 4 point on-hit return into 5 points.

Worked Link example: Fireball plus SkillDelay plus Echo pays Mana once and starts its cooldown at commit. At t=2.0 s the projectile releases (assuming no base wind-up); at t=2.45 s the echo projectile releases. The primary's damage/heal/barrier magnitude receives 1.35; the echo receives 1.35\*.70=.945 of the unmodified magnitude, with ordinary other modifiers applied once. Projectile flight time still follows each projectile's release and travel; the delay is not repeated on every hit or chain.

# 14\. Known evidence limits and authoring backlog

The API/UI proof, installed asset catalog, native weapon/animation metrics, exact audio IDs, production NPC move validation, global C/K binding mechanism, C reverse-camera unbind/remap path, native Inventory-extension path and deployment performance measurements cannot be invented in a document. They are concrete Phase 00/connected-test deliverables. Public Hytale HUD/custom-page APIs justify the planned adapter surfaces, but do not certify client layout or arbitrary global hotkeys in the pinned build. All missing formulas in the current gameplay scope have an initial rule here; “local evidence required” is a separate issue from “design formula undefined.”

Distinctive final glyphs, aura rings, scythes, roots, poison textures and icon illustrations may remain ART\_TEMPLATE for development and functional release candidates. Template readiness must be tested with the artist's override pack entirely removed. A unique appearance can be commissioned later without changing the logical skill. Phantasm remains a name awaiting an approved effect. Ten replacement skill concepts from the older 97 target remain unfilled; do not count them as executable skills.

Enemy coverage is not a sum of unrelated databases. The catalog below has 66 unique proposed source names and 21 UNASSIGNED skills. The legacy planning metric “62 of 128 combat-oriented enemies lack a skill” is not independently verified because the complete 128 enemy registry is absent and the proposed assignment pool includes some wildlife. Phase 12 outputs the actual normalized enemy registry and its unassigned set. Do not publish a precise current-game enemy total until that audit exists.

## B.2 Inherited generic-moveset review backlog \[S1\]

These are source-authored research notes, not newly verified movesets. Audit current NPC assets/gameplay before promotion.

| Enemy | Observed/Public Combat Identity | Design Action |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Trork (unarmed) | Basic punches; public descriptions explicitly call out short reach, modest damage, and no special mechanics. | Needs a new signature technique. |
| Trork Brawler | Heavy melee swings and sustained pressure; mechanically straightforward bruiser behavior. | Needs a more distinctive bruiser signature. |
| Trork Warrior | Weapon \+ armor create role identity, but public descriptions do not expose a discrete special attack. | Needs a disciplined weapon signature. |
| Goblin Scavenger | Basic melee swings; opportunistic/scavenging behavior is flavorful AI rather than a discrete player skill. | Needs a dirty-trick or scavenger-themed signature. |
| Goblin Scrapper | Charges into melee and swings crude weapons aggressively; current Quick Slash assignment is functional but generic. | Strong redesign candidate. |
| Skeleton Soldier | Front-line charge-and-swing behavior; no clear signature mechanic in public descriptions. | Needs a military/formation signature. |
| Skeleton Fighter | Common melee undead role; no clearly distinguished special attack surfaced in the reviewed public material. | Needs a signature melee technique. |
| Skeleton Ranger | Keeps range and fires steadily; Crossbow Bolt is mechanically generic. | Could become a pinning/suppressing precision skill. |
| Sandswept Skeleton Soldier | Backbone melee/tomb-defense role; public descriptions emphasize durability and aggression rather than a special attack. | Needs a desert/tomb-guard signature. |
| Yeti | Public descriptions emphasize heavy melee swings, durability, and raw damage rather than a unique active mechanic. | Current Avalanche assignment requires production validation or redesign. |
| Outlander Colossus | Public descriptions emphasize heavy, telegraphed attacks and bulk, but no discrete signature move. | Needs a Colossus-specific heavy technique. |

**\[W23\] Hytale CustomPage**

https://docs.hytale.com/api/com/hypixel/hytale/protocol/packets/interface\_/CustomPage

Current public protocol exposes custom pages, commands and event bindings. It supports the standalone Character/Link pages but does not by itself prove native Inventory widget injection.

**\[W24\] Hytale Page enum**

https://release.server.docs.hytale.com/com/hypixel/hytale/protocol/packets/interface\_/Page

Public enum exposes Inventory and Custom as distinct page values. Treat direct native Inventory augmentation as unproven; use the standalone Character page until a supported composition path is demonstrated.

**\[W25\] Hytale SetPage packet**

https://docs.hytale.com/api/com/hypixel/hytale/protocol/packets/interface\_/SetPage

Public packet changes the active page and close-through-interaction behavior. Exact server wrapper/client flow remains a pinned-build adapter concern.

## D.2 First handoff instruction

Read this master and the seed-data README. Execute PHASE00 ONLY.  
Preserve the repository, saves and unrelated mods. Produce the pinned  
build/capability and installed-asset audit, including real-client proofs  
for Link canvas pan/drag/key/spline behavior, CustomUIHud/CustomPage,  
Health/Mana/Stamina visibility, all available Ability inputs, C Character,  
K Link Tree, removal/remap of the current C camera-flip action, and whether  
a supported native Inventory extension/composition path exists. Do not  
implement the full skill/passive catalog, migrate production data, patch  
opaque client binaries, claim art readiness from asset names, or automatically  
continue to Phase01. Return PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED evidence and the smallest  
authorised next step.
